title: Kula Today
heading: Today · Sat 21 Nov
summary: A light day (forecast moderate). Thermals stayed light all day. The upslope ran from about 09:00 to about 19:00. Yesterday evening, the page called it normal, about 5,200 ft, a hit. Midday the base averaged about 4,600 ft by the Kekoa camera, 600 ft lower than yesterday evening's number; the morning update said about 5,200 ft, off by 600 ft; at 10:00, from the 09:00 base, about 5,000 ft, off by 400 ft. Most of the day the shear line was crossing Kula Highway near Omaopio; furthest north about 09:22, crossing Kula Highway near Kamehameha Schools; furthest south about 15:07, crossing Kula Highway at the middle Lower Kula Road junction. Data gaps: no readings all day from 3 stations (Kahikinui, Nakula, Upper Kahikinui); the Mesonet could not be reached on 46 of 55 updates.
